title: Crew of Hampden P5303
memorial_details: description: DEDICATED TO THE CREW/ OF/ HAMPDEN P5303/ FROM/ No.16 OPERATIONAL TRAINING UNIT/ RAF UPPER HEYFORD/ WHO LOST THEIR LIVES ON NOVEMBER 1ST 1941/ DURING A CROSS COUNTRY TRAINING FLIGHT WHEN THEIR/ AIRCRAFT WAS STRUCK BY LIGHTNING./ (names)/ WHEN YOU GO HOME, TELL THEM OF US AND SAY/ "FOR YOUR TOMORROWS THESE GAVE THEIR TODAY"
